name: travel guitar
caption: A travel guitar with a short body, a compact neck and a small head. A waisted body joins a long neck; the headstock carries tuning studs. Curved body edges keep an even thickness around the sound hole. Overall width is 0.70 times depth; height is 1.80 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous dark brown, tan, near black color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
